instr: Hanyar kai kaya: ku tsara zagaye mafi gajarta daga ma'aji ta kowace tasha sannan a koma.
clue: Ku fara daga ma'aji (murabba'i mai duhu), ku ziyarci kowace tasha mai lamba sau ɗaya, sannan ku koma ma'ajin. Ku sa dukkan tafiyar ta zama gajarta gwargwadon iko (ana auna nisa a miƙaƙƙen layi). Ku danna tashoshin bisa jerin da za ku ziyarce su, ko ku rubuta lambobinsu. Soke (maɓallin Backspace) yana cire tasha ta ƙarshe. Ku danna Na gama (maɓallin Enter) idan kowace tasha tana cikin hanyarku. Ku danna Fara idan kun shirya.
